notes.title: RollRiddle - Cube'n'Roll: Discover the Mysteries at a Discount!
notes.content:
RollRiddle - Cube'n'Roll: Discover the Mysteries at a Discount!

Ready for a unique logic adventure? In RollRiddle - Cube'n'Roll, you’ll navigate through various levels, controlling mysterious cubes and solving increasingly complex puzzles. Now, with our latest update, you can enjoy a smoother experience and exciting new features!


Bug Fixes: 

 We've resolved issues with level loading, optimized controls for better responsiveness, and fixed minor graphical glitches.
 The game now supports only 64-bit systems, providing improved performance and enhanced stability.
 The user interface now displays correctly on ultra-wide screens.
 We’ve addressed a number of small gameplay issues to ensure smoother play sessions.


New Features: 

 Enjoy a brand-new level selection screen, enhanced sound effects, and improved visual feedback when solving puzzles! 
 You can now save your game using Steam Cloud, allowing you to continue your adventure on any device, exactly where you left off. 
 You can now enjoy the game with full controller functionality for a more immersive experience.
 And much much more....!



Now’s the perfect time to join the RollRiddle community at a discounted price! The offer is only available for a limited time, so don’t miss your chance to become a master of puzzles!

notes.title: RollRiddle Major Update: Complete Overhaul!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce a major update for RollRiddle! We've completely rethought and redesigned the gameplay to enhance your experience. The player movement system has been revamped for smoother and more responsive controls, and the UI has been completely redesigned for better accessibility and navigation.

New features include the addition of achievements, offering a range of challenges to test your skills. We've also added over 90 skins to customize your characters and show off your style. Compete with others on the newly implemented leaderboards and see how you stack up against players worldwide!

On top of all that, we've made numerous optimizations to ensure RollRiddle runs more smoothly than ever. We can't wait for you to try out these improvements!

Enjoy the update, and thanks for your continued support!
